يستعفون (form X)
# يَسْتَعْفُونَ (yastaʕfūna) /jas.taʕ.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# يُسْتَعْفَوْنَ (yustaʕfawna) /jus.taʕ.faw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
